headline: Global Markets Rally as Gold Hits Record Highs and US Treasury Yields Decline
summary: Global stock markets surged 3% while gold prices climbed above $4,000 per ounce. The rally follows a decline in the US dollar and Treasury yields amid ongoing US election uncertainty.
why: Gold is traditionally viewed as a safe-haven asset during periods of political or economic instability, while lower Treasury yields often boost equity valuations by reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Safe-haven demand and falling yields typically drive gold prices higher.
